records.readable_german: Gleicstrom ohne Kraftqelle versandbereit. Bei Nachrcef angefragt, ob Bukarest senden sollen.
records.title: Bucharest dispatch enquiry and power-source specifications
records.meaning: The fragment reports readiness for dispatch without a power source and says that the office represented by NACHRCEF was asked whether the item should be sent to Bucharest. It does not confirm that dispatch took place. The exact item is not identified by this surviving part alone.
records.reading_note: All 162 original coordinates are present, including the final VA omitted by the earlier OCR block. Four observed-coordinate substitutions propose GLEICSTROM, VERSAND and BEREIT for GLEICSTVOM, VEDSAND and BERBIT. The residual forms GLEICSTROM, KRAFTQELLE and NACHRCEF are retained exactly: no missing H or U is added to produce fluent modern spellings. This is the source-defined second part; the first part is outside this edition. The following third part supplies a direct power-source query but does not establish that equipment was obtained or transported.

records.readable_german: Ist Kraftqelle, Motor etwa 50 PS mit 220 Volt Gleichstr. Dynamo 25 KW, dort beschaffbar oder Triebw. Kraftanlage verwendbar; Funkantwort.
records.title: Direct query for a motor about 50PS, 220V direct-current dynamo and 25kW rating
records.meaning: Asks whether a power source—a motor of about 50 PS with a 220-volt direct-current dynamo rated 25 kW—can be procured there, or whether the power installation denoted TRIEBW can be used. Requests a radio reply. The message asks about availability and does not establish that the equipment exists there or was sent.
records.reading_note: All 228 observed coordinates yield 114 fixed plaintext positions without any substitution, fill, deletion or insertion. The quantities 50PS, 220VOLT and 25KW are direct raw labels. The source final group is FXX, whereas earlier OCR had FAX. KRAFTQELLE remains the literal spelling; GLEICHSTR and TRIEBW remain abbreviations, and TRIEBW is not expanded into a particular vehicle or plant type. The semicolon before FUNKANTWORT is editorial punctuation only.
